claim_text: Under H1-H3, constant-step Brownian-motion-based diffusion flow matching has a KL upper bound whose explicit dimension-dependent factor is O(d^3), improving the cited prior O(d^4) factor, and whose terms separate drift approximation epsilon^2 from discretization proportional to h.

assumptions.H2: standard Gaussian marginals have finite eighth moments d(d+2)(d+4)(d+6)
assumptions.H3: the independent Gaussian joint density is positive C-infinity and its score has finite L8 norm

acceptance_criteria: An independent symbolic checker proves the current theorem factor divided by d^3 tends to a finite nonzero constant.
The same checker proves the cited prior factor divided by d^4 tends to a finite nonzero constant.
The exact Euler endpoint KL decreases for every tested dimension as h decreases.
At fixed d and h, the KL increment from q is quadratic in epsilon.
All designed negative controls are rejected.
fail_policy: Any failed acceptance criterion terminates the verifier with a nonzero exit code.
